throughline.zh: 10/11 至 10/17 的五個主題，聚焦台灣與東南亞：晶圓與記憶體供給、整機櫃供電、台灣終端與布局、馬來西亞人才，以及越南投資落地。依已發布的 10/12 至 10/17 日報整理，同一事件只歸入一個主題。
throughline.en: Five themes for October 11–17 focus on Taiwan and Southeast Asia: chip and memory supply, rack power, Taiwan endpoints and footprint, Malaysian talent, and Vietnam investment execution. Based on published October 12–17 editions, with each event assigned once.

title.zh: 台積電、美光與南亞科公布晶圓、HBM 和 DRAM 進展
title.en: TSMC, Micron and Nanya report wafer, HBM and DRAM developments

summary.zh: 台積電法說與美光 AATT2 開幕提供先進邏輯、HBM 與後段測試資訊，南亞科財報涵蓋一般 DRAM。各來源的產品、期間與產能口徑不同，未公布的新增產出及設備訂單仍未知。
summary.en: TSMC’s earnings call and Micron’s AATT2 opening provide advanced-logic, HBM and backend information; Nanya reports conventional DRAM. Product, period and capacity definitions differ, while undisclosed added output and tool orders remain unknown.

title.zh: 聖荷西 OCP 台廠展示高壓直流電源與液冷
title.en: Taiwan vendors exhibit high-voltage DC power and liquid cooling at San Jose OCP

summary.zh: 台廠於美國加州聖荷西 OCP 展示機櫃、電源、備援與冷卻，本週另有台電投資及電源專利調查消息。展示額定值與實際部署量分開記錄，專利程序的結果仍待後續文件。
summary.en: Taiwan vendors showed racks, power, backup and cooling at OCP in San Jose, California; the week also included Taipower investment and a power-patent investigation. Exhibit ratings are separate from deployed volumes, and the patent proceeding awaits further records.

title.zh: 台灣終端 AI、工廠合作與海外園區規劃
title.en: Taiwan local AI, factory collaborations and overseas park plans

summary.zh: RTX Spark 宣布上市，NVIDIA 公布工廠 AI 合作；經濟部說明赴美園區規劃，中經院發布全年預測。上市、合作、規劃與預測各有不同資料狀態，出貨、全面部署、用地及融資細節尚未全部公開。
summary.en: RTX Spark availability and NVIDIA factory collaborations were announced, while Taiwan’s ministry described U.S. park plans and CIER issued a forecast. Availability, collaborations, plans and forecasts have distinct status; shipment, full deployment, land and financing details remain incomplete.

title.zh: 吉隆坡 KLCC 半導體招募涵蓋設計、製程與設備
title.en: KLCC semiconductor recruitment covers design, process and equipment

summary.zh: 馬來西亞吉隆坡 KLCC 招募涵蓋設計、製程、設備與廠務，官方描述與檳城製造及封測聚落互補。職缺與園區人數為不同指標，實際聘用未公布，主辦頁對活動起日記載有差異。
summary.en: Recruitment at KLCC in Kuala Lumpur covers design, process, equipment and facilities, with officials describing links to Penang manufacturing and backend clusters. Vacancies and park headcounts are distinct measures; actual hiring is undisclosed and organizer pages differ on the start date.

title.zh: 越南資料中心電價與前三季外資統計
title.en: Vietnam data-center tariffs and nine-month FDI statistics

summary.zh: 胡志明市要求釐清資料中心電價，最終費率及原始會議文件尚未取得；10 月 3 日發布的前三季 FDI 實現額估計年增 12.1%。個案電價與全國統計分開記錄，外資註冊額、實現額及製造業分項的分母亦不同。
summary.en: Ho Chi Minh City sought tariff clarification, with final tariffs and original meeting records unavailable; October 3 data estimated nine-month realized FDI growth at 12.1%. Project tariffs and national statistics remain separate, as do the denominators for registered, realized and manufacturing investment.
